description: Header file defining the t_client structure and functions for the SRP (Secure Remote Password) client-side negotiation, including session management, key generation, and verification.

methods.name: t_clientopen
methods.description: Initializes an SRP client session with username and parameters N, g, s.

methods.name: t_clientgenexp
methods.description: Generates a random 256-bit exponent and computes g raised to that power.

methods.name: t_clientpasswd
methods.description: Sets the user's password in the client state.

methods.name: t_clientgetkey
methods.description: Computes the session key from the server's exponential y(p).

methods.name: t_clientresponse
methods.description: Computes the session key proof as SHA(y(p), K).

methods.name: t_clientclose
methods.description: Closes the session and frees resources.
